name: MoHowl
description: Author-motif feedback howl for NTS-3. Pad-triggered JP-8080-style comb scream: X = pitch, Y = feedback, hold to sustain. SWOOP lifts the attack like a yell; DEC is the release.

params.name: HARM
params.detail: Comb harmonic spacing (same as FbOsc HARM)

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Release time after lifting the pad
